create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a GTN graph by adding start/accept nodes and arcs with labels and weights
test_graph_weight_operations: test getting and setting graph arc weights as lists, numpy arrays, or raw pointers
test_graph_comparison_and_isomorphism: test whether two GTN graphs are equal or isomorphic using gtn.equal and gtn.isomorphic
test_graph_save_and_load: test saving and loading GTN graphs to/from files using savetxt/loadtxt or save/load
test_autograd_backward_pass: test automatic differentiation on GTN graphs by calling backward and retrieving gradients
